formula.nonzero: min(globalFieldLimit, max(countedFieldDepth(member) for member in originalPremise)+1)
formula.anchor: Original method premise, not the previous local conclusion; fixed for one original relation.
formula.ND: Model helper uses maximum member depth; the counterexample uses singleton premises only.

method: New external Kotlin proposal model calls current ApOps.applyEdge, ApOps.limit, current layered C2 DemandStore.initials and current paired C5 DemandStore.intersect. Only the collector budget argument changes in the local model. Production actor, driver and AP source bytes are untouched.

principalCase.normalSource: The caller has exact root p.$/T NORMAL from an unconditional source. Its ZERO origin permits the full global budget. The deep path is created only inside make under nonzero initial p.$/T.
principalCase.normalSinkSeed: The caller has exact root return/T requirement NORMAL at the sink. The deep path is created only inside backward take under nonzero initial ret.$/T.

middleAdmission.forwardTake: guide arg0.a.[any]/T + actual arg0.a.[any]/T DEMAND -> initial arg0.a.[any]/T DEMAND
middleAdmission.backwardMake: guide ret.a.[any]/T + actual ret.a.[any]/T DEMAND -> initial ret.a.[any]/T DEMAND
middleAdmission.lostInformation: The unknown b suffix cannot be reconstructed from same-prefix ANY actuals.

principalCase.C5: The raw forward take ret.[any]/T DEMAND meets its paired exact ret.$/T exit and selects ret.$/T DEMAND. Backward make selects arg0.$/T DEMAND. C5 does not promote the layer.
principalCase.nonstickyNextInitials: Those selected exact guides plus the actual exact NORMAL source/sink still emit the same depth-0 exact NORMAL outer initials. Previous guide DEMAND is not a sticky start-layer floor.
principalCase.fixedPoint: The six-item middle/initial/selected-row fingerprint is identical at every tested global budget 1..7. All four relevant crossing value relations are DEMAND under the relative cap. Under the unchanged global cap all four are NORMAL once global>=2.
principalCase.nativeReplay: No NORMAL deep crossing value relation is produced by either helper under the relative policy. Unchanged identity records and a shallow ZERO-source record do not restore the missing b suffix. The test counts layer eligibility of these four relevant value relations; it does not assert the whole program has zero NORMAL records.
principalCase.TargetConsequence: The may witness remains available in DEMAND. These modeled relations cannot yield a NORMAL sink witness. This is a consequence of the existing layer/NormalTarget contract, not a direct full-driver Target test.

positiveControl.source: A separate unconditional ZERO-origin source supplies exact arg0.a.b.$/T NORMAL. Full global capacity is retained for ZERO.
positiveControl.admission: Submitted exact a.b refines the ANY guide to initial arg0.a.b.$/T NORMAL, depth 2.
positiveControl.outcome: NORMAL ret.$/T for each tested global budget 2..7. A reader alone with this explicit deep source is not a progress counterexample.
